feeds.title: ANAD Blog
feeds.description: The ANAD blog contains articles on eating disorder awareness, prevention, recovery, and more. Check back often for new information.

feeds.title: My Journey away from Anorexia
feeds.description: This blog is a place for me to vent and talk about life with anorexia, depression and PTSD, that I hope one day I will soon recover from. Recently discharged from an ed unit so please read with caution.

feeds.title: Yoga For Eating Disorders Blog
feeds.description: Jennifer is an author, inspirational speaker, & yoga therapist specializing in eating disorders & body image. She is the founder of Yoga For Eating Disorders.

feeds.title: .:Too Much, Not Enough:.
feeds.description: Isabella Rayne. 23 years old, from Australia. Apart from that, I'm just a bundle of diagnoses.

feeds.title: Bev Mattocks | Mother, Writer & Eating Disorders Awareness Advocate
feeds.description: Boys get eating disorders, too, just like girls. In 2009 Bev Mattocks Osborne's 15-year old son developed anorexia. Now, aged 23 and studying for a Masters Degree at university, he is thankfully recovered. This blog is her story. Bev is a 57-year old freelance copywriter lives in Yorkshire, UK.

feeds.title: BeautyBeyondBones
feeds.description: This blog chronicles the author journey from severe anorexia to recovery and every twist and turn along the way. The blog posts are meant to be read from beginning to end, as a book. This blog is for parent or loved one of someone suffering with an eating disorder. Perhaps you're in the throes of anorexia yourself.

feeds.title: Eating Disorder Recovery for Adults
feeds.description: Eating Disorder Recovery for Adults information, blog, podcast and resources from recovered adult sufferer Tabitha Farrar.

feeds.title: I Haven't Shaved In 6 Weeks - Truths About Eating Disorders
feeds.description: Blog about all The Truths About Eating Disorders, Rehab, and Recovery by Lindsey Hall, a PCOS Warrior and a Day-time Publicist.

feeds.title: Rebecca Quinlan Blog
feeds.description: Bex's blog shares her anorexia recovery journey & discusses eating disorders & mental health. Rebecca Quinlan's aim is to talk about the little things that make a BIG difference for those who are suffering or have suffered from Anorexia.

feeds.title: Fighting Anorexia
feeds.description: A blog about my Anorexia recovery. Karly, diagnosed with Anorexia almost three years ago and have been battling it ever since. On her blog she shares different experiences and her recovery, to inspire people with eating disorders to fight for a happier and healthier life.

feeds.title: R is for Recovery (and Rebekah)
feeds.description: This blog was started in October 2011 when I was recovering from Anorexia Nervosa and Bulimia Nervosa. I use this blog as a means of educating, communicating and putting eating disorders in perspective. R is for Recovery is also a Christian blog.

feeds.title: Bridgette and Goliath - Recovering from Anorexia
feeds.description: Bridgette Thurber, 20 year old living in the Pacific Northwest, recovering from Anorexia. Shares her journey about recovery and treatment.

feeds.title: Mirijam Buschmann
feeds.description: I want to let God's grace and glory, His presence and power become visible through my life. I want to use my story to be a bearer of peace and freedom. May my blog serve this purpose.

feeds.title: Michelle Sparkes Podcast | Illuminating Anorexia & Eating Disorder Recovery
feeds.description: Michelle Sparkes, Health professional, author, speaker, long term recovered survivor of anorexia and EDNOS. Her mission is to help the people struggling with eating disorders and disordered eating.

feeds.title: Eleven and anorexic
feeds.description: A blog about anorexia authored by the Undulating Runner.

feeds.title: Kiera's Recovery Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog! My name is Kiera DeCesare. Kiera's Recovery Blog chronicals my life recovering from Anorexia as a teenager and the unique perspectives it gives me. I hope you'll follow along as I share my recipes, narrative essays, and other random things.
